title: Sparkler Logic
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: A high-energy C minor sawtooth groove driven by a dense TR-707 kit — double-time hi-hats, scattered rims and toms, crashing open hats — with a filter-swept bass that tears open wide in the chorus. A pentatonic sawtooth lead cuts through with delay-soaked riffs that ping-pong across the stereo field.
